plain: A formal statement of strong disapproval

webster.text: The act of blaming or finding fault and condemning as wrong; applicable to the moral conduct, or to the works of men.

more.text: To condemn by a judicial sentence, as in ecclesiastical affairs.

example.quote: In the first place, a distant prospect of public censure would be a very feeble restraint on power from those excesses to which it might be urged by the force of present motives.
